svg.title: This is also a CSV
svg.desc: A plain CSV file of flights, captioned "This is a CSV." Its lines fly into a split-flap departures board: "This is also a CSV." So are a resume, the periodic table, whose 118 lines land on their tiles in order, a WhatsApp group chat and an airplane seat map. Every one is a CSV with CSS on top: the departures board turns over to show its file, a style block above the CSV. Deleting the CSS gives the plain CSV back. The CSV you already have, the CSS you already know, one plain-text file. CSSV, Comma-Separated Styled Values: one script tag, no build step, cssv.dev.

div.span: /* Each remark comes from the sign of the delay. */
/* One flight, picked out by its key. */

tr.td: Data engineer with ten years of building pipelines people trust: streaming ingestion, warehouse modelling and the tooling around them. Happiest where data meets product, turning vague questions into reliable tables and dashboards. Leads by writing things down, pairing generously and leaving systems easier to run than before.
Designed the streaming platform behind live departure data for 1,400 stations, replacing nightly batches with updates that arrive within five seconds.
Led the migration of 300 Airflow DAGs to dbt and Dagster, cutting failed runs by 70% and onboarding time for new engineers from weeks to days.
Introduced data contracts between product teams and the platform, ending a whole class of silent schema breaks.
Mentors four engineers and runs the fortnightly data guild.
Kafka, Flink, dbt, Dagster, Snowflake, Python, Terraform, AWS
“Ines rebuilt our most fragile system while it was running, and wrote it all down so the rest of us could follow. Our on-call nights have been quiet ever since.”
Priya Raman - VP Engineering @ Kestrel Rail
Built the demand-forecasting feature store used by 600 stores, reducing fresh-food waste by 12% in its first year.
Rebuilt the customer data warehouse on BigQuery, bringing the daily load down from six hours to 40 minutes.
Set up data quality checks across 180 tables, with failures routed to the team that owns each table.
Interviewed and hired five engineers and ran the team's on-call rotation.
Python, Spark, BigQuery, Airflow, Great Expectations, Looker, GCP
Brought appointment and prescription data from 40 clinics into one warehouse, pseudonymising patient data at ingestion.
Automated the monthly regulatory reports that had taken an analyst a week to compile.
Wrote the team's first style guide for SQL and data modelling.
Developed REST APIs and reporting dashboards for logistics clients.
Moved deployments from hand-run scripts to continuous integration with automated tests.
Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, Jenkins
Dissertation: forecasting bike-share demand from weather data
Streaming, batch ETL, dimensional modelling, data contracts, data quality, privacy by design
Kafka, Flink, Spark, dbt, Dagster, Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery
Mentoring, technical writing, hiring, incident reviews
